Military Force.label: DefenceEstablishment
Military Force.comment: A defence establishment, such as an army or navy base.

Military Force.label: LegalForceStatus
Military Force.comment: A list of possible statuses for the legal force of a legislation.

Military Force.label: GovernmentService
Military Force.comment: A service provided by a government organization, e.g. food stamps, veterans benefits, etc.

Military Force.label: State
Military Force.comment: A state or province of a country.

Region.label: DefinedRegion
Region.comment: A DefinedRegion is a geographic area defined by potentially arbitrary (rather than political, administrative or natural geographical) criteria. Properties are provided for defining a region by reference to sets of postal codes. Examples: a delivery destination when shopping. Region where regional pricing is configured. Requirement 1: Country: US States: "NY", "CA" Requirement 2: Country: US PostalCode Set: { [94000-94585], [97000, 97999], [13000, 13599]} { [12345, 12345], [78945, 78945], } Region = state, canton, prefecture, autonomous community...

Region.label: AdministrativeArea
Region.comment: A geographical region, typically under the jurisdiction of a particular government.

Region.label: State
Region.comment: A state or province of a country.

Region.label: Continent
Region.comment: One of the continents (for example, Europe or Africa).

Person.label: Person
Person.comment: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

Person.label: Residence
Person.comment: The place where a person lives.

Person.label: Question
Person.comment: A specific question - e.g. from a user seeking answers online, or collected in a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document.

Person.label: IndividualProduct
Person.comment: A single, identifiable product instance (e.g. a laptop with a particular serial number).

Country.label: State
Country.comment: A state or province of a country.

Country.label: SearchResultsPage
Country.comment: Web page type: Search results page.

Temporal Expression.label: Time
Temporal Expression.comment: A point in time recurring on multiple days in the form hh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see [XML schema for details](http://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#time)).

Temporal Expression.label: SeekToAction
Temporal Expression.comment: This is the [[Action]] of navigating to a specific [[startOffset]] timestamp within a [[VideoObject]], typically represented with a URL template structure.

Temporal Expression.label: Schedule
Temporal Expression.comment: A schedule defines a repeating time period used to describe a regularly occurring [[Event]]. At a minimum a schedule will specify [[repeatFrequency]] which describes the interval between occurrences of the event. Additional information can be provided to specify the schedule more precisely. This includes identifying the day(s) of the week or month when the recurring event will take place, in addition to its start and end time. Schedules may also have start and end dates to indicate when they are active, e.g. to define a limited calendar of events.

Temporal Expression.label: DateTime
Temporal Expression.comment: A combination of date and time of day in the form [-]CCYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see Chapter 5.4 of ISO 8601).

Military Aircraft.label: Airline
Military Aircraft.comment: An organization that provides flights for passengers.

Military Aircraft.label: Vehicle
Military Aircraft.comment: A vehicle is a device that is designed or used to transport people or cargo over land, water, air, or through space.

Military Aircraft.label: DefenceEstablishment
Military Aircraft.comment: A defence establishment, such as an army or navy base.

Locality.label: Residence
Locality.comment: The place where a person lives.

Locality.label: SportsActivityLocation
Locality.comment: A sports location, such as a playing field.

Locality.label: CivicStructure
Locality.comment: A public structure, such as a town hall or concert hall.

Locality.label: PlaceOfWorship
Locality.comment: Place of worship, such as a church, synagogue, or mosque.

News Agency.label: NewsMediaOrganization
News Agency.comment: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

News Agency.label: NewsArticle
News Agency.comment: A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news. A more detailed overview of [schema.org News markup](/docs/news.html) is also available.

News Agency.label: Report
News Agency.comment: A Report generated by governmental or non-governmental organization.

Armed Group.label: MusicGroup
Armed Group.comment: A musical group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a choir. Can also be a solo musician.

Armed Group.label: PerformingGroup
Armed Group.comment: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.

Armed Group.label: DanceGroup
Armed Group.comment: A dance group—for example, the Alvin Ailey Dance Theater or Riverdance.

Armed Group.label: TheaterGroup
Armed Group.comment: A theater group or company, for example, the Royal Shakespeare Company or Druid Theatre.

Summit.label: Mountain
Summit.comment: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

Summit.label: MeetingRoom
Summit.comment: A meeting room, conference room, or conference hall is a room provided for singular events such as business conferences and meetings (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conference_hall ). See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations .

Summit.label: Continent
Summit.comment: One of the continents (for example, Europe or Africa).

Summit.label: Cooperative
Summit.comment: An organization that is a joint project of multiple organizations or persons.

City.label: Residence
City.comment: The place where a person lives.

City.label: Mountain
City.comment: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

International Agreement.label: AgreeAction
International Agreement.comment: The act of expressing a consistency of opinion with the object. An agent agrees to/about an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

International Agreement.label: Order
International Agreement.comment: An order is a confirmation of a transaction (a receipt), which can contain multiple line items, each represented by an Offer that has been accepted by the customer.

International Agreement.label: Legislation
International Agreement.comment: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

International Agreement.label: PayAction
International Agreement.comment: An agent pays a price to a participant.

International Agreement.label: Cooperative
International Agreement.comment: An organization that is a joint project of multiple organizations or persons.

Resort.label: Resort
Resort.comment: A resort is a place used for relaxation or recreation, attracting visitors for holidays or vacations. Resorts are places, towns or sometimes commercial establishments operated by a single company (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Resort ). See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations .

Resort.label: VacationRental
Resort.comment: A kind of lodging business that focuses on renting single properties for limited time.

Resort.label: LodgingBusiness
Resort.comment: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

Resort.label: Hotel
Resort.comment: A hotel is an establishment that provides lodging paid on a short-term basis (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotel). See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations .

Government Ministry.label: GovernmentOffice
Government Ministry.comment: A government office—for example, an IRS or DMV office.

Government Ministry.label: State
Government Ministry.comment: A state or province of a country.

Government Ministry.label: AdministrativeArea
Government Ministry.comment: A geographical region, typically under the jurisdiction of a particular government.

Government Ministry.label: GovernmentService
Government Ministry.comment: A service provided by a government organization, e.g. food stamps, veterans benefits, etc.

Newspaper.label: Newspaper
Newspaper.comment: A publication containing information about varied topics that are pertinent to general information, a geographic area, or a specific subject matter (i.e. business, culture, education). Often published daily.

Newspaper.label: NewsArticle
Newspaper.comment: A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news. A more detailed overview of [schema.org News markup](/docs/news.html) is also available.

Newspaper.label: Article
Newspaper.comment: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

Newspaper.label: Periodical
Newspaper.comment: A publication in any medium issued in successive parts bearing numerical or chronological designations and intended to continue indefinitely, such as a magazine, scholarly journal, or newspaper.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

Newspaper.label: BackgroundNewsArticle
Newspaper.comment: A [[NewsArticle]] providing historical context, definition and detail on a specific topic (aka "explainer" or "backgrounder"). For example, an in-depth article or frequently-asked-questions ([FAQ](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FAQ)) document on topics such as Climate Change or the European Union. Other kinds of background material from a non-news setting are often described using [[Book]] or [[Article]], in particular [[ScholarlyArticle]]. See also [[NewsArticle]] for related vocabulary from a learning/education perspective.

Body of Water.label: SeaBodyOfWater
Body of Water.comment: A sea (for example, the Caspian sea).

Body of Water.label: BodyOfWater
Body of Water.comment: A body of water, such as a sea, ocean, or lake.

Body of Water.label: Canal
Body of Water.comment: A canal, like the Panama Canal.

Document Collection.label: Collection
Document Collection.comment: A collection of items, e.g. creative works or products.

Document Collection.label: ProductCollection
Document Collection.comment: A set of products (either [[ProductGroup]]s or specific variants) that are listed together e.g. in an [[Offer]].

Document Collection.label: Dataset
Document Collection.comment: A body of structured information describing some topic(s) of interest.

Religious Site.label: PlaceOfWorship
Religious Site.comment: Place of worship, such as a church, synagogue, or mosque.

Demographic Group.label: MusicGroup
Demographic Group.comment: A musical group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a choir. Can also be a solo musician.

Demographic Group.label: StatisticalPopulation
Demographic Group.comment: A StatisticalPopulation is a set of instances of a certain given type that satisfy some set of constraints. The property [[populationType]] is used to specify the type. Any property that can be used on instances of that type can appear on the statistical population. For example, a [[StatisticalPopulation]] representing all [[Person]]s with a [[homeLocation]] of East Podunk California would be described by applying the appropriate [[homeLocation]] and [[populationType]] properties to a [[StatisticalPopulation]] item that stands for that set of people. The properties [[numConstraints]] and [[constraintProperty]] are used to specify which of the populations properties are used to specify the population. Note that the sense of "population" used here is the general sense of a statistical population, and does not imply that the population consists of people. For example, a [[populationType]] of [[Event]] or [[NewsArticle]] could be used. See also [[Observation]], where a [[populationType]] such as [[Person]] or [[Event]] can be indicated directly. In most cases it may be better to use [[StatisticalVariable]] instead of [[StatisticalPopulation]].

Demographic Group.label: SizeGroupEnumeration
Demographic Group.comment: Enumerates common size groups for various product categories.

Demographic Group.label: PerformingGroup
Demographic Group.comment: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.

Demographic Group.label: PeopleAudience
Demographic Group.comment: A set of characteristics belonging to people, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

Media Organization.label: NewsMediaOrganization
Media Organization.comment: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

Media Organization.label: Organization
Media Organization.comment: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.

Media Organization.label: Article
Media Organization.comment: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

Media Organization.label: SearchRescueOrganization
Media Organization.comment: A Search and Rescue organization of some kind.

Media Organization.label: PerformingGroup
Media Organization.comment: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.
